tldr: Moon through the 6th house brings focus to work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance.
body: Moon transiting the 6th house stirs work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports daily systems and practical support: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or overwork or neglecting the body.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 6th house deliberately. Work with work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
